sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the maintenance procedure P1, to be performed 
on an annually as indicated by Y1 in the title block

This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
operation and calibration of the directional earth fault over current relay.

The document 
is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing personal 
injury or damage to equipment

The AT31X1 relay is an over current, secondary, time independent device for 
electrical equipment at over loads and short circuits. They are mostly used in 
such cases where low consumption in the current circuits and high resetting are 
required.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed 
 Bahie Abdel-Wanes, accepted by eng. Ragheb 
 Abd Raboh: general director, and approved by eng. Fathy 
 Mohamed Ibrahem: Head Sector of Siouf Power Station.

This document certified by 
eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer A and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety helmet, safety shoes ... ets
The voltage transformer must be out of services.
CB must be opened and tagged out.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Over Current Test

Disconnected the circuit 
breaker.

Remove the input current 
terminals (7,8,9,10) from terminal board (A).

Connect test leads between 
the current terminal (7&10) for phase (R).

Increase by injected 
current slowly until the red indication on the over current element phase R on 
the relay appears

Record this value on the 
test sheet (adjust it if needed).
Switch off the set.

Repeat the above test from 
step (3) to step (6) but inject current between terminal (8,10) for phase (S) 
and terminals (9,10) for phase (T) on the terminals board (A).

sections.text: Time Test

Connect the delayed 
contact numbers (1,2) on the relay to timer terminals on the test set.

Start the test by 
injecting the pick up current into the relay for phase (R)

Record the value of time 
on the test sheet (adjust it if needed)

The timer will stop once 
the relay has pick up.

Repeat the above for phase 
(S) & (T)

Put the circuit breaker on

sections.text: Return Relay to Service

Disconnect the test leads 
from the terminal board and connect the relay terminals no 7,8,9 and 10 of the 
relay to normal work condition.

Disconnect the test leads 
from timer terminal on the relay and connect the time delay terminals of the 
relay to the normal condition.

If any equipment 
associated with the relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by 
the following restoration steps:
Connect the breaker trip coil to work condition.
